definition: A document store whose zones can be shared between organisations' nodes, synchronised in both directions.
definitionCite: LedgerHub is a document store whose zones can be shared between organisations' nodes

operations.name: shareZone
operations.note: the zone is then synchronised to the other node, both ways
operations.cite: Use shareZone to share a zone with another node

operations.name: writeDoc
operations.cite: Use writeDoc to write a document into a zone

operations.name: readDoc
operations.cite: readDoc returns a document from a zone

operations.name: watchDoc
operations.cite: watchDoc calls you back for every document that changes in a zone

rules.text: A shared zone is synchronised to every node it is shared with, in both directions
rules.why: a write on either node appears on the other
rules.cite: A shared zone is synchronised to every node it is shared with, in both directions

rules.text: Synchronisation copies documents as they are, without checking who wrote them
rules.why: anything a partner writes into a shared zone arrives here
rules.cite: Synchronisation copies documents as they are; it does not check who wrote them
